biotools.summary: This is a package for analysis of case-control data in genetic epidemiology. It provides a set of statistical methods for evaluating gene-environment (or gene-genes) interactions under multiplicative and additive risk models, with or without assuming gene-environment (or gene-gene) independence in the underlying population.
